name: Writing
example: “Correct this text” — fix, improve, shorten or translate selected text.
panel.timeout: Lumo took too long to answer. Try a shorter selection.
panel.failed: Lumo couldn’t answer. Your text wasn’t changed.
panel.changed: The text changed since you selected it. Copy the result instead.
panel.local: On this computer · nothing goes online
settings.what: Select text in any LordOS text field and right-click: ✨ AI ▸ correct spelling and grammar, improve the writing, make it shorter or translate it. The answer appears in a panel; your text changes only when you click Replace.
settings.noModel: Writing needs a language model. Install one in Brain.
settings.privacy: Lumo runs on this computer with the local engine; the selected text never leaves it. Apps never talk to the model: LordOS asks it and hands the app only the text you choose to replace. Never offered in password fields.
settings.how: Up to 4,000 characters at a time. The model can be wrong: read the result before you replace your text.
brain.usedBy: Lumo’s functions: {list}, and Monitor’s “Investigate with Lumo”
brain.tryNeeds: To try it, turn on Writing or Sentinela.
